# prompts.toml

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown prompts.toml`; do not edit -->

Location: beside providers.toml: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/prompts.toml, else ~/.config/letibot/prompts.toml

system-prompt overrides: replace a built-in section or append text, for every model or one

## `[base]`

Every model. An unknown table or section name fails the file; the built-in prompt is used.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `system_extra` | string | none | appended last to the system prompt |
| `identity` | string | built-in | replaces the `identity` section; empty = built-in |
| `language` | string | built-in | replaces the `language` section; empty = built-in |
| `tree` | string | built-in | replaces the `tree` section; empty = built-in |
| `find_and_read` | string | built-in | replaces the `find_and_read` section; empty = built-in |
| `edit_files` | string | built-in | replaces the `edit_files` section; empty = built-in |
| `view` | string | built-in | replaces the `view` section; empty = built-in |
| `scratch` | string | built-in | replaces the `scratch` section; empty = built-in |
| `notes` | string | built-in | replaces the `notes` section; empty = built-in |
| `working` | string | built-in | replaces the `working` section; empty = built-in |
| `tone` | string | built-in | replaces the `tone` section; empty = built-in |
